works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 加密钱包质押 App：暖金橄榄渐变底上斜放多部手机，中央屏余额 $17,340、Send/Request 按钮与折线图一目了然；左侧质押数字键盘配“Swipe to Trade”，右侧再叠一层面积图；金融 App 用“斜放多屏、一屏一功能”的拼贴，把余额、质押、交易三件事一次讲清。
works.comment_en: Crypto wallet and staking app: several phone screens float at an angle over a warm gold-olive gradient — the center screen shows a $17,340 balance with Send/Request buttons and a line chart, the left one a staking keypad with "Swipe to Trade", the right one an area chart — a "one screen, one job" collage that tells balance, staking and trading in a single glance.
works.title: Crypto Wallet & Staking Mobile App UI Design

works.author: Tanvir for Yscale Studio
works.comment: 数字银行官网 Sprig：深森林绿底，大标题“Banking that works as hard as you do”，4.20% 利率与 $250,000 存款数字直接当卖点；生活方式照片配浅绿卡片，金融官网用深绿做信任感、再用真实照片拉近距离的组合很稳。
works.comment_en: Sprig digital banking site: a deep forest-green page headlined "Banking that works as hard as you do", leading with a 4.20% rate and a $250,000 deposit figure; lifestyle photos and pale-green cards soften the finance — dark green for trust, real photography for warmth, a steady fintech homepage pairing.
works.title: Sprig — Modern Digital Banking Website Design

works.author: Alamin Hossen
works.comment: AI 语音转文字 SaaS 定价页：浅灰底上 Starter / Pro / Team 三档并列，Pro 卡用黑色“Go Pro Plan”按钮高亮，$0、$14.99、$29.99 三档价格一目了然；SaaS 定价页“中间档加粗、切换入口放顶部”的经典排布，干净利落。
works.comment_en: AI voice-to-text SaaS pricing page: Starter, Pro and Team tiers sit side by side on a light gray page, the Pro card highlighted with a black "Go Pro Plan" button and prices of $0, $14.99 and $29.99; the classic "spotlight the middle tier, put the toggle up top" pricing layout, cleanly executed.
works.title: SaaS Pricing Page UI/UX — AI Voice to Text Platform

works.author: Husain
works.comment: AI 植被管理网站：黑白技术插画风配一枚红色太阳圆点，大标题“SEE EVERY TREE NEAR YOUR POWER LINES”，输电塔与树木线稿、2,936 / 48 / 63% 三组数据；冷门工业题材用插画风讲 AI 巡检，比堆仪表盘截图有记忆点得多。
works.comment_en: AI vegetation-management website: a black-and-white technical-illustration style with a single red sun, headlined "SEE EVERY TREE NEAR YOUR POWER LINES", power-line towers and tree linework beside figures like 2,936 / 48 / 63%; an unglamorous industrial topic made memorable by illustration instead of dashboard screenshots.
works.title: AI-Powered Vegetation Management Website

works.author: Uzzal (AI Product Designer)
works.comment: 活动发现 App：奶油底色上三部手机并排，“Discover Amazing Events Near You”配“AI Global Leadership Summit”活动卡片，橙色 CTA 与圆角图片点出主操作；票务类 App 用暖底色加一枚高饱和 CTA 的组合，浏览感很轻。
works.comment_en: Event-discovery app: three phones on a cream backdrop — "Discover Amazing Events Near You" with an "AI Global Leadership Summit" event card, orange CTAs and rounded imagery; a warm base with one high-saturation accent makes browsing for tickets feel light.
works.title: Event Discovery App UI – Explore Events & Book Tickets Mobile

works.author: Habibur Rahman (AI Product Designer)
works.comment: 网络安全学习 App HackLab：深红黑底三部手机，登录页“Welcome Back! Master Ethical Hacking”，课程页按 Networking / Linux 分类、配 Learning Hours 柱状图，末屏 IBM 证书与成就徽章；学习类 App 把“证书”当作视觉终点，激励链路很完整。
works.comment_en: HackLab cybersecurity-learning app: three phones on a deep red-black backdrop — a "Welcome Back! Master Ethical Hacking" login, a course page split by Networking and Linux with a Learning Hours bar chart, and an IBM certificate page with achievement badges; ending the flow on the certificate makes the motivation loop feel complete.
works.title: HackLab Mobile App Design Explore Cybersecurity, Network Defense
